summary: iter39 re-retest of the 4 iter37 fixes, run fresh (--cache-clear, no cached artifacts, backend confirmed RUNNING). Verified file contents on disk first, then executed 23 pytest tests (20 in updated test_iter37_phase_q.py + 2 new in-process prune tests + 1 WS read test) and 4 live browser checks against the public URL. ALL 4 FIXES CONFIRMED WORKING. iter38's report was indeed inaccurate.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid HTML nesting: the pro-handle <Link> (<a href=/u/:handle>) is rendered inside the pro-card <Link> (<a href=/directory/:id>). React logs 'In HTML, <a> cannot be a descendant of <a> ... will cause a hydration error' on every Directory render. Functionally the stopPropagation click still works, but nested anchors are invalid and risk hydration mismatches. Suggest making the card a div with onClick/navigate, or moving the handle link outside the card anchor.

verified_fixes: messaging_router: 3 x thread.get('participants') hits (list_messages L43, mark_thread_read L59, broadcast branch L68). Backend test with dm_threads doc {thread_id:'test-user-t1-a-test-user-t1-b', participants:[dashed ids]} -> GET /api/messages/{tid} = 200 with history, POST /{tid}/read = 200 marked=1. Non-participant on an existing thread still correctly 403 (both GET and POST).

directory_router /api/contact: throttle now AFTER validation (L117-130), hits.append at L149-150 after send_email. HTTP test: 3x400 invalid then valid submission -> 200 (was 429); only 1 row persisted. 3 valid -> 200,200,200, 4th -> 429; different IP not throttled. In-process unit test: _CONTACT_RATE['9.9.9.9']=[0.0] is pruned on the next request; 4 invalid payloads record zero hits.

Messages.jsx: 2 x '/read' hits (loadMessages L34, WS handler L47). Live browser: recipient opening thread with 2 unread inbound msgs fired POST /api/messages/{tid}/read; with the thread open, a WS-delivered inbound message rendered and fired /read again; sender's bubble flipped receipt-sent-<id> -> receipt-read-<id> live via WS message.read after the peer marked read.

Directory.jsx L47: computed color of pro-handle is rgb(226,232,240) (text-slate-200) on the premium card and rgb(100,116,139) (text-slate-500) on featured/basic cards — matches the fix; contrast is acceptable on both.

critical_code_review_comments: mark_thread_read recomputes `parts` twice (L59 and L68) — harmless but redundant; the L68 line can be deleted.

current_user_from_token resolves the session_token cookie ahead of the Authorization header. Not a bug, but test scripts must clear browser cookies when impersonating a second user via page.request (caused a false negative in my first browser run).
_CONTACT_RATE is per-process in-memory; with multiple backend workers the 3/10min quota is per-worker. Acceptable for now, worth noting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter37_phase_q.py now asserts the CORRECT post-fix behaviour: TestContactRateLimit::test_invalid_submissions_do_not_consume_quota expects 200 after 3x400, and TestReadReceipts has test_dashed_user_id_participant_allowed (inserts dm_threads doc, expects 200) plus test_non_participant_on_existing_thread_403. Use a unique X-Forwarded-For per contact rate-limit test. For two-user browser tests, clear cookies before using page.request with a different bearer token (cookie wins over header).
